title: Canonical profinite parameter evaluation
statement: For a commutative condensed ring R, scheme X and profinite P, use the existing free internal module R[P]. Define its universal parameter generator, tensor/internal-Hom evaluation after point pullback, and its ordinary derived evaluation. The comparison p_X^* RHom(R[P],N) → R(rho_P)_*p_{X[P]}^*N is precisely the rho_P-adjunct of that derived evaluation, using the canonical point-pullback comparison. Its natural transformation is natural in N. These are the existing ProfiniteFunctions constructions, also specialized to all-continuous coefficients by def-sfb-derived-profinite-evaluation; no invertibility assertion is part of the definition Built from [def-sfb-condensed-free-module-adjunction], [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [def-sfb-derived-profinite-evaluation].

def comparisonApp (X : Scheme.{u}) (P : Profinite.{u})
    (N : DerivedCategory (PointModules R)) :
    (pointPullD R X).obj ((functions R P).obj N) ⟶
      (CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward R.X (projection X P)).obj
        ((pointPullD R (testScheme X P)).obj N)
